tests.name: Repeatable load
tests.detail: two fresh loads both pass verification; check output and results JSON identical (apart from the run time)

tests.name: Delivered database matches a fresh load
tests.detail: mar-postgres gives the same check results as the fresh self-test load

tests.name: Damaged copy detected
tests.detail: one comment edited, one ticket deleted, the username index dropped: verify exits 1 and names tickets (count, hash), comments (hash), the users index and the case rule; untouched tables still pass

tests.name: Tampered metadata hash detected
tests.detail: roles hash zeroed in a copy of the metadata: verify exits 1 with exactly one failure, naming roles

tests.name: Corrupted input refused
tests.detail: one byte changed in 02-data-sanitized.sql: load exits 2 on the integrity check and creates no container

tests.name: Existing database protected
tests.detail: load without --recreate on an existing container exits 3 and changes nothing

tests.name: Docker unavailable reported
tests.detail: with Docker unreachable, the tool exits 2 with a clear message
